sourceQuote: Copy of Foreigner Physical Examination Form (for applicants who are currently not studying at Chongqing Normal University) Completed Physical Examination Form for Foreigners together with the original copy (lab copy of AIDS, sexually transmitted diseases, type B Hepatitis and X-ray) of the health examination from hospitals with red stamp.
targetQuote: 外国人体检表复印件（适用于目前未在重庆师范大学就读的申请者）已完成并填写完毕的外国人体检表，以及健康检查报告原件复印件（包括艾滋病、性传播疾病、乙型肝炎和X光检查的实验室报告复印件），并加盖医院红章。
